able_to_function: Konrad Function left a grandmother who prays for both armies behind in Northwick and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet.
Konrad Function went out with the wiring party at N-F2. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Konrad Dooficus and Konrad Function sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

Konrad Function counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Rafael "Brick" Rsurnevski never saw the shovel coming. (@rsurnevski2020) Konrad Function was on watch at N-F2 when the night raid hit. The men found Konrad Function at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Valentin "Spark" Waxy of the Hegemony (@waxy4422).
The papers connected Jakub "Mud" Function to Konrad Function. The men took longer to learn Jakub "Mud" Function's own habits, but they made the effort.
anime_freek23: Pavel "Brick" Freek left his mother, who writes every Sunday behind in Halden and came up the line with a frozen apple. The men noticed at once that he whistles the same four notes over and over.

Pavel "Brick" Freek checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Pavel "Brick" Freek watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Pavel "Brick" Freek had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
Pavel "Brick" Freek bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Pavel "Brick" Freek checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
Pavel "Brick" Freek practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at U-F12. Pavel "Brick" Freek was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Otto "Rabbit" Kocibaaaaaaa of the Hegemony (@bbbbbbbbennnn_kocibaaaaaaaa).
Casimir Freek arrived carrying the family name of Pavel "Brick" Freek. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
burger_rambo: Day 14: Roland Rambo reached N-F16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Roland Rambo was carrying water up to N-F16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Roland Rambo did not. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen of the Concord (@moonroleen). A single shot at N-F16. Roland Rambo sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen of the Concord (@moonroleen).
The House of Rambo sent another. Hugo Rambo, uncle of Roland Rambo, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Hugo Rambo jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Wendel "Spark" Itfc. The Concord medics will be busy. (@stanleyl_itfc) Hugo Rambo went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Gideon Senpai was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@emelryk_senpai) Night raid. Hugo Rambo crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Hugo Rambo. Hugo Rambo was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at N-F16. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Roland Dav of the Concord (@dav.cl_). Hugo Rambo read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
callumcranit: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Edmund Callumcranit. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Edmund Callumcranit got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. A letter from home found Edmund Callumcranit before the night shift. Edmund Callumcranit folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Edmund Callumcranit watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Edmund Callumcranit taught Viktor Gravesiiclay to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home found Edmund Callumcranit before the night shift. Edmund Callumcranit folded it small and kept it close.
Edmund Callumcranit wrote back to Josef and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.

Edmund Callumcranit and Marek Limaecho both swear they saw a ghost at Saint-Ash crossroads. Each says the other screamed first. A letter from home found Edmund Callumcranit before the night shift. Edmund Callumcranit folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Callumcranit was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at P-F23. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Felix Panzerfaust of the Hegemony (@panzerfaust5803). A letter from home found Edmund Callumcranit before the night shift. Edmund Callumcranit folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Callumcranit sat on an ammunition box at P-F23 with a bandaged leg and gave advice to everyone who passed. Nobody asked for it. A letter for Edmund Callumcranit came with a photograph. Edmund Callumcranit looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
celeriton.design: They issued Walter "Ghost" Design a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Walter "Ghost" Design measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Walter "Ghost" Design during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Walter "Ghost" Design. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Walter "Ghost" Design of the Hegemony spotted Ivo "Mud" Samwade of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Brickworks. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Walter "Ghost" Design added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
On sentry duty Walter "Ghost" Design watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

A single shot from across the wire hit Walter "Ghost" Design in the thigh at T-F7. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Jonas "Hollow" Argall of the Concord (@james_argall_05). Walter "Ghost" Design was killed on watch at T-F7. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Jonas "Hollow" Argall of the Concord (@james_argall_05).
Another member of the House of Design reached the line: Leopold "Brick" Design. He asked where Walter "Ghost" Design had slept, then chose a different corner.
dillonl07: On the way to R-R8, Gustav Dillonl tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Gustav Dillonl shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Dillonl. Gustav Dillonl read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Gustav Dillonl's bunk. He has named it Bishop. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Dillonl. Gustav Dillonl read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Grey Mill. Gustav Dillonl let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Gustav Dillonl remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Dillonl. Gustav Dillonl read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Bishop the rat now waits for Gustav Dillonl at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.

Bishop ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Gustav Dillonl followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Bishop his life. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Dillonl. Gustav Dillonl read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Dillonl kept Zeno Martinvajda awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Gustav could have walked there blind. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Dillonl. Gustav Dillonl read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Dillonl traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not. The runner said a letter for Gustav Dillonl had come up with the ammunition. Gustav Dillonl went to get it before the ammunition.
evan.little.14: Silas "Brick" Little left twin brothers too young to enlist behind in Belmonte and came up the line with a child's drawing of a horse. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet. Silas "Brick" Little's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Silas "Brick" Little heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas "Brick" Little. Silas "Brick" Little read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Across from S-R11, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Silas "Brick" Little saw it. Henrik "Shadow" Hume was grazed. Silas "Brick" Little was hit through the chest at S-R11. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson of the Hegemony (@loganarneson_). A single shot at S-R11. Silas "Brick" Little sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Karel "Smokes" Loganarneson of the Hegemony (@loganarneson_).

The House of Little sent Jonas Little after Silas "Brick" Little. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. The clerk counted the names twice. Jonas Little is number 845 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Little kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Machine-gun fire swept S-R11. Jonas Little took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla).
Jonas Little lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.

The medics called Jonas Little 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Jonas Little is back on the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Little. Jonas Little read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The village shop had three kinds of soap. Jonas Little stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required.
Yann Liamroberts kept watch so that Jonas Little could sleep. Then Jonas kept watch so that Yann could. Neither slept.
frankly_franz: Rafael "Owl" Franz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 4. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Rafael "Owl" Franz said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Rafael "Owl" Franz tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F4 is up. Rafael "Owl" Franz raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F4. Rafael "Owl" Franz has learned to walk bent double.
Rafael "Owl" Franz's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
On a quiet night Rafael "Owl" Franz (Concord) and Jonas Nicopaoletto (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.

Rafael "Owl" Franz hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier. The signallers took Rafael "Owl" Franz in on a busy morning in R-F4. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

A note came over the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Konrad Danielmcmena.' Rafael "Owl" Franz sang louder. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

At R-F4 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Rafael "Owl" Franz turned around and took a shovel blow. Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs of the Hegemony (@lilmaggs21). Rafael "Owl" Franz went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Oskar "Mud" Pyyro put up a fight, but not for long. (@pyyro.2030) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Rafael "Owl" Franz snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Rafael "Owl" Franz free. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Rafael "Owl" Franz stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Rafael "Owl" Franz no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier. Rafael "Owl" Franz got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 243. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Rafael "Owl" Franz helped stack spare sandbags at R-F4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Rafael "Owl" Franz taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Rafael "Owl" Franz lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Rafael "Owl" Franz went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F4. Rafael "Owl" Franz took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Arno Cadendareal of the Hegemony (@cadendareal2). Rafael "Owl" Franz stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F4. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Arno Cadendareal of the Hegemony (@cadendareal2).
Yann "Rabbit" Franz asked about Rafael "Owl" Franz on arriving at R-F4. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F4. Yann "Rabbit" Franz was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Tobias Euphoria of the Hegemony (@gndr_euphoria).
A letter came with Dorian Franz: "I am Yann "Rabbit" Franz's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
franzcalamari: Zeno Franzcalamar came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Jonas Miked pulled Zeno Franzcalamar out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Zeno Franzcalamar read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Zeno Franzcalamar counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Bram "Button" Nailonailon lent Zeno Franzcalamar a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Zeno Franzcalamar thought about a wife and a daughter he has never met on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
Zeno Franzcalamar had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Gustav Bobopomaranc crossed it, Zeno Franzcalamar fired. Gustav Bobopomaranc was grazed.
Zeno Franzcalamar fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Norbert Cos was badly wounded trying to cross it.
jake_81590: Nobody asked Leopold "Tin" Jake why he came. Nobody in Q-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F16, Leopold "Tin" Jake listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Tin" Jake. Leopold "Tin" Jake read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold "Tin" Jake found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Tin" Jake. Leopold "Tin" Jake read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Leopold "Tin" Jake looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Leopold "Tin" Jake raised his head for a heartbeat too long at Q-F16. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Karel "Lucky" Keegan of the Hegemony (@keegan7.92). Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Tin" Jake. Leopold "Tin" Jake read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Three days with a bandage, and Leopold "Tin" Jake is back at Q-F16. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Tin" Jake. Leopold "Tin" Jake read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit the sandbag next to Leopold "Tin" Jake's ear at Q-F16 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Tin" Jake. Leopold "Tin" Jake read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Leopold "Tin" Jake is whole again, or near enough for the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Tin" Jake. Leopold "Tin" Jake read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold "Tin" Jake jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Bram Industriousb. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@industriousbear) Leopold "Tin" Jake went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Henrik "Brick" Sunley was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@alex_sunley) Leopold "Tin" Jake made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Leopold "Tin" Jake crawled the last yards. Nobody could reach Leopold "Tin" Jake in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.

Another member of the House of Jake reached the line: Marek Jake. He asked where Leopold "Tin" Jake had slept, then chose a different corner. Marek Jake's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
kebapien22: The sergeant gave Silas Kebapien a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Silas Kebapien during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Silas Kebapien was found at the bottom of the trench at R-R1, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Emil Stoppingklou of the Concord (@stoppingkloud). A single shot at R-R1. Silas Kebapien sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Emil Stoppingklou of the Concord (@stoppingkloud).

The House of Kebapien sent Felix Kebapien after Silas Kebapien. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Victory at Grey Mill. Felix Kebapien let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The gun crews at R-R1 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Felix Ryanstebbins was badly wounded.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R1 and grazed Felix Kebapien's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Henrik Tobiasweighi of the Concord (@tobiasweighill).
The medics cleaned Felix Kebapien's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-R1.

A clear shot from R-R1. Felix Kebapien badly wounded Florian Kurkalubos and slid back down below the parapet. Felix Kebapien was carrying water up to R-R1 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Felix Kebapien did not. Shot by Valentin Hect of the Concord (@hect_fr1).
Felix Kebapien spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
mrcakerson: Hugo Mrcakerson walked into S-S12 on Day 5 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Hugo Mrcakerson hates silence more than shelling. Today, under fire at Saint-Ash crossroads, that habit was the only steady thing in S-S12.
Hugo Mrcakerson started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Hugo Mrcakerson and Tobias Deadeyesimul divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Hugo Mrcakerson kept watch so that Ulrich Nothing could sleep. Then Ulrich kept watch so that Hugo could. Neither slept.

A round went through the rim of Hugo Mrcakerson's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Gustav Mini of the Concord (@mini_i.r.s). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Hugo Mrcakerson could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Hugo Mrcakerson returned to S-S12 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Hugo Mrcakerson is number 428. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Hugo Mrcakerson shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The whole squad at S-S12 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Hugo Mrcakerson's bullet that found Arno Olie, grazed.
Hugo Mrcakerson's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Hugo Mrcakerson worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.

Hugo Mrcakerson fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Jakub Ronne was gravely wounded. A round went through Hugo Mrcakerson's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Silas Charlieshort of the Concord (@charlieshort5.0).
Back on the fire step at S-S12. Hugo Mrcakerson says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
nilsiiboy12: The old hands of S-C4 have been here since Day 1. Yann Nilsiiboy has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Yann Nilsiiboy was hit in the forearm at S-C4. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Karel Lynallwarrio of the Concord (@lynallwarrior51). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Yann Nilsiiboy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Yann Nilsiiboy is whole again, or near enough for the line. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Yann Nilsiiboy answered to number 842. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Yann Nilsiiboy watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Yann Nilsiiboy as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Yann Nilsiiboy waited for the password before answering.
Yann Nilsiiboy kept Teodor Collinhaney awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Yann could have walked there blind.
A report called the trench satisfactory. Yann Nilsiiboy invited the author to spend a night in it before signing.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Yann Nilsiiboy. The men named it Inkwell and said it had chosen him.
packmoto500: Isidor Packmoto arrived on Day 15 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Isidor Packmoto came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
panzerfaust5803: Felix Panzerfaust came up the line with a rosary of rough beads and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Felix Panzerfaust found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Felix Panzerfaust and Viktor Mohawk argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Felix Panzerfaust's bunk. He has named it Bishop.

Felix Panzerfaust counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Jonas Dalton was grazed. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Felix Panzerfaust aimed a step ahead and fired: Edmund Callumcranit, grazed.

At P-F22 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Felix Panzerfaust turned around and took a shovel blow. Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Isidor "Owl" Chypotatoes of the Concord (@crun_chypotatoes).
patrickktz: Jakub Patrickktz, a tailor from Marrow Fen, was sent forward on Day 11 to fill a gap in U-F5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Jakub Patrickktz helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Jakub Patrickktz pulled Henrik Damnitsamir out of a flooded shell hole at the Sunken Road. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Jakub Patrickktz (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Florian "Ash" Rybilton (Concord) at Saint-Ash crossroads. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge. A letter from home reached Jakub Patrickktz before dusk. Jakub Patrickktz read it twice and slept a little easier.
At roll call, Jakub Patrickktz's place stayed empty. Someone said another section might have taken him in. A runner was sent to ask.

Jakub Patrickktz came back exhausted, having waited in cover until the way cleared. He slept through the argument about who had worried most. A letter from home reached Jakub Patrickktz before dusk. Jakub Patrickktz read it twice and slept a little easier.
Jakub Patrickktz spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
proto_guyy: In Lindenbruck, Oskar "Smokes" Guyy was a medical student. In R-F14, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a medical student again.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy answered the first call, number 69 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.
The rain did not stop once. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy slept standing up, wedged against the wall of R-F14, and dreamt of dry socks.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F14 is up. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
The corporal found out Oskar "Smokes" Guyy used to be a medical student. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy has been doing two jobs ever since.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F14. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Jakub Virajvirxgil of the Hegemony (@virajvirxgill13). Oskar "Smokes" Guyy was killed on watch at R-F14. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Jakub Virajvirxgil of the Hegemony (@virajvirxgill13).

Florian "Doc" Guyy put a tin whistle beside the bunk. Someone who had known Oskar "Smokes" Guyy helped clear the shelf without saying why. Florian "Doc" Guyy is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.

Florian "Doc" Guyy felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F14. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Freddie of the Hegemony (@0__freddie__0). Florian "Doc" Guyy was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Henrik Sedlomancz was badly wounded.

Florian "Doc" Guyy's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-F14 with the rations. Florian "Doc" Guyy ate while listening to the revised orders.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Florian "Doc" Guyy changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Florian "Doc" Guyy stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Florian "Doc" Guyy across the shin at R-F14. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Henrik Zdawg of the Hegemony (@zdawg_44).
Back on the fire step at R-F14. Florian "Doc" Guyy says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

Florian "Doc" Guyy was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F14. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Aversa of the Hegemony (@aariele_aversa). Florian "Doc" Guyy was killed at R-F14 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Aversa of the Hegemony (@aariele_aversa).
Another member of the House of Guyy reached the line: Albin "Hollow" Guyy. He asked where Florian "Doc" Guyy had slept, then chose a different corner.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Albin "Hollow" Guyy's ear at R-F14 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Wendel Realshayanwo of the Hegemony (@realshayanworld).

Albin "Hollow" Guyy was hit in the hip at R-F14. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Isidor Serrano of the Hegemony (@ana_serrano_7). A single shot at R-F14. Albin "Hollow" Guyy sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Isidor Serrano of the Hegemony (@ana_serrano_7).
The papers connected Pavel Guyy to Albin "Hollow" Guyy. The men took longer to learn Pavel Guyy's own habits, but they made the effort.
rei0_shi4: The new rifleman is Severin "Lucky" Shi, once a coal miner from Saint-Lune. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Severin "Lucky" Shi said he would find out.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F8, Severin "Lucky" Shi listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
The salvo walked along R-F8 and caught Severin "Lucky" Shi in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos.
Severin "Lucky" Shi spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.

No bed for Severin "Lucky" Shi yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Severin "Lucky" Shi wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Severin "Lucky" Shi died waiting. The men at R-F8 have not stopped talking about it.
The papers say Benedikt Shi. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Severin "Lucky" Shi's eyes. Nobody in R-F8 argues.

Benedikt Shi fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Gustav "Mud" Raptor, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home reached Benedikt Shi before dusk. Benedikt Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Fog hid the far end of R-F8. Benedikt Shi kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. A letter from home reached Benedikt Shi before dusk. Benedikt Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt Shi waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Yann Spring did, and was grazed. A letter from home reached Benedikt Shi before dusk. Benedikt Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.
Benedikt Shi was on watch at R-F8 when the night raid hit. The men found Benedikt Shi at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Gideon "Mole" Deale of the Concord (@richard.deale).

Casimir Shi took the same post at R-F8 where Benedikt Shi stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Casimir Shi's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Casimir Shi fell asleep on watch. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn took over without waking Casimir, and told the sergeant nothing. A letter from home reached Casimir Shi before dusk. Casimir Shi read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Casimir Shi is number 152. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Casimir Shi did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Casimir Shi and Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Casimir Shi and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Casimir Shi fired. Jonas Rockytheauti was grazed.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Casimir Shi gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

Casimir Shi opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter from home reached Casimir Shi before dusk. Casimir Shi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias "Rabbit" Forn lent Casimir Shi a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. A thin letter reached Casimir Shi. Only five lines long, and Casimir Shi knew every one of them by heart before supper.
salutem_primum_: Norbert "Bones" Primum walked into P-F8 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Norbert "Bones" Primum let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne was gravely wounded. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Norbert "Bones" Primum kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Norbert "Bones" Primum shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Pavel Schizophreni, was badly wounded.
Ivo "Tin" Chappell lost a boot in the trench. Norbert "Bones" Primum found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Norbert "Bones" Primum was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert "Bones" Primum. Norbert "Bones" Primum read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

There is a sniper across the way the men call the Clockmaker. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Clockmaker hit all three. Norbert "Bones" Primum watched where the shots came from. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert "Bones" Primum. Norbert "Bones" Primum read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Norbert "Bones" Primum found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. Norbert "Bones" Primum read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.
santiago.g.adauto: Day 5. The corporal put Karel Adauto beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Karel Adauto's hands still remember being a tram conductor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Karel Adauto read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Karel Adauto started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.
Karel Adauto and Bastian Christianbar sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

Bastian Christianbar gave Karel Adauto the last match in the trench. Karel used it to light a candle so that Bastian could finish a letter. A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.

Karel Adauto's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point." A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.

Night raid. Karel Adauto crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Karel Adauto. The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F1 they left Karel Adauto behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Enjoyer of the Hegemony (@autism_enjoyer_08).
Florian Adauto joined S-F1 under the shadow of Karel Adauto's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

The parcel for Florian Adauto contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. A letter from home reached Florian Adauto before dusk. Florian Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian Adauto answered to number 358. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-F1. Florian Adauto has learned to walk bent double.
A flare lit Saint-Ash crossroads like noon. Florian Adauto counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Florian Adauto drew a map of Arno "Smokes" Den's hometown from Smokes's stories. Smokes says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home reached Florian Adauto before dusk. Florian Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.
Florian Adauto shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.

The men at S-F1 heard Florian Adauto call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k). Florian Adauto stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F1. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k).

Walter Adauto came to the front because his older brother Florian Adauto never came home. He carries a frozen apple. Walter Adauto reported for duty as a sapper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Bastian Red and Walter Adauto cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. There was a letter for Walter Adauto. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Walter Adauto laughed for the first time in days.
shooter.conqueror_napoleon: Leopold "Crow" Napoleon joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Leopold "Crow" Napoleon watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of P-F13. Leopold "Crow" Napoleon fired at the last man to run. Viktor Jcksn was grazed. Grey Mill is lost. Leopold "Crow" Napoleon heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Leopold "Crow" Napoleon raised his head for a heartbeat too long at P-F13. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Roland Jester of the Hegemony (@jester.404).
The medics cleaned Leopold "Crow" Napoleon's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at P-F13.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Leopold "Crow" Napoleon fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Casimir Yelloowman and Leopold "Crow" Napoleon share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Across from P-F13, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Leopold "Crow" Napoleon saw it. Roland Jester was grazed.
st0nk_boy: The old hands of S-S16 have been here since Day 1. Severin "Crow" Boy has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Severin "Crow" Boy fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-S16. Before dawn Arno Nathangrundm walked into it, badly wounded. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Severin "Crow" Boy wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Severin "Crow" Boy lent Florian Exe a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Severin "Crow" Boy is number 604. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Severin "Crow" Boy helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Severin "Crow" Boy aimed a step ahead and fired: Edmund Streekluukva, grazed.
Severin "Crow" Boy taught Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Severin "Crow" Boy brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

Severin "Crow" Boy fired at a movement across the wire at S-S16. The man went down: Silas Kitty, grazed. A clear shot from S-S16. Severin "Crow" Boy grazed Isidor Jacksondeehr and slid back down below the parapet.

Severin "Crow" Boy felt a hard tug at his hip at S-S16. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Quentin "Tin" Cpurvis of the Concord (@cpurvis_4).
state_approved_idiot: Roland "Ghost" Idiot told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
A rat stole Roland "Ghost" Idiot's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Roland "Ghost" Idiot let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A new recruit would not eat with the others. Roland "Ghost" Idiot left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Roland "Ghost" Idiot is number 576. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Roland "Ghost" Idiot helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The recruit sat beside Roland "Ghost" Idiot at supper but left before the talk began. Roland "Ghost" Idiot passed the bread without trying to start a conversation.
A round went through the rim of Roland "Ghost" Idiot's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Benedikt Azok of the Concord (@azok_78046).
Roland "Ghost" Idiot came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-S2. Roland "Ghost" Idiot fired at the last man to run. Jakub Khattabka was gravely wounded. Roland "Ghost" Idiot had just lit a cigarette at S-S2 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Otto Summacon of the Concord (@summacon1).
The medic looked at Roland "Ghost" Idiot's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-S2. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
zzkaake: At the depot, Karel Zzkaake had practised answering to his name. At R-R11, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R11, Karel Zzkaake listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Karel Zzkaake across the shin at R-R11. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg of the Hegemony (@eventhatoneguywastaken). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Karel Zzkaake is number 852. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Karel Zzkaake stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A round came through the loophole Karel Zzkaake was watching at R-R11 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Isidor Serrano of the Hegemony (@ana_serrano_7).
A medic stopped by Karel Zzkaake's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Karel Zzkaake had gone back to R-R11.
In the rear quarters, Karel Zzkaake played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated.
Severin Masterofecli taught Karel Zzkaake to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Karel Zzkaake took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-R11, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche of the Hegemony (@elliott_goyhenetche).
